requirement: Claims, premises and supporting evidence
reported_finding: Each claim is linked to the evidence that supports it and to the domain in which it applies.

requirement: Scope of the final generalizations
reported_finding: Conditions on a general conclusion are recorded separately for each level of evidence.

requirement: Conjugacy of forcing and readout, dimensions and masses
reported_finding: Forcing and its conjugate readout use the normalization of the core operators. Units are specified for the reduced fluoride models.

requirement: Conservation, passivity and limiting cases
reported_finding: The reduction preserves positivity of the Schur complement. The residual of the equations of motion is checked with all seven centres free to move.

requirement: Gauss law, direct and adjoint readouts, and gauge in the static core with halo
reported_finding: Gauss's law and the direct and adjoint readouts are checked on the same static core and halo.

requirement: Three-dimensional time-dependent current and spatial convergence
reported_finding: Convergence of the three-dimensional current is tested for the specified operator and spatial windows.

requirement: Threshold of the charged sector
reported_finding: The threshold for the charged solution is given for the specified vacuum mass and sector conditions.

requirement: Normalization and independent electrical identity
reported_finding: One charge normalization carries over to atomic lines, radii and bonds. The standards constrain a combination of parameters.
condition: Charge identity independent of the fine-structure calibration retains the evidential status given in the register. Two standards for the same constant cannot establish that identification on their own.

requirement: Transport of degrees, geometry and responses
reported_finding: The same observation geometry and parameters apply to all twelve preparations.

requirement: Balance laws and convergence of transported operators
reported_finding: The weights and poles of the projected operators are checked for each preparation.

requirement: Weights, moments, positivity and causality
reported_finding: The reservoir reduction preserves the weights, moments and causality of this realization.

requirement: Matching to a physical reservoir and current
reported_finding: The core defines a reservoir current. Flux through the faces of the volume is evaluated on five grids.

requirement: CO₂ band centre near 728 at fixed parameters
scope: benchmark agreement with competing interpretations unresolved
reported_finding: The prediction for the centre of the CO₂ band at 728 cm⁻¹ uses the specified preparation and frozen parameters.

requirement: Gases, rotations and spectra at the reference conditions
reported_finding: The gas, rotation and spectroscopy measurements are identified together with their reference conditions.

requirement: Held-out predictions, covariances, uncertainty budgets and controls
scope: benchmark agreement with competing interpretations unresolved
reported_finding: The held-out predictions and comparison conventions are documented. Appendix C gives the neon example.

requirement: Electrostatic source, reciprocal readout and negative controls
reported_finding: The electrostatic calculation uses one operator for the reciprocity tests and their controls.

requirement: Lossy propagation, phase and clock
reported_finding: The cosmological propagation comparisons share a background, matter fraction, perturbation closure and effective mass.

requirement: Detector, calibration and feedback
reported_finding: One vector readout couples the six arms of SF₆ to the detector. The intensities are compared with the measurement windows and the 6,970 samples of the weak band.

requirement: Provenance and access to evidence files
reported_finding: Each supporting file is identified by its path and checksum.

requirement: Reproducing restoration
reported_finding: The distribution supplies the replay commands and the corresponding reference outputs.

requirement: Composition, measurement and entanglement
reported_finding: Probabilities and spacings of the collective harmonic system are computed for fifteen preparations using the action scale of the fluoride family.

requirement: Spin and exchange statistics
reported_finding: The sign associated with rotation and exchange is checked along the specified closed paths.

requirement: Gauge structure and Gauss law
reported_finding: For both fluoride families and fifteen geometries, the same construction of induced links satisfies the Gauss, covariance and positivity checks. Its physical identification is a hypothesis.

requirement: Matter, strong interactions and spectrum
reported_finding: Four excitations of the collective realization yield twelve levels on the fifteen geometries with the action scales of the fluoride families.
condition: The fifteen outputs leave open the assignment of this spectrum to physical strong-interaction states. The effective gauge model is admissible, subject to that qualification.

requirement: Weak current, chirality and symmetry violations
reported_finding: The angular correlations of the weak current and the reduced-mass distribution use the same shared parameters as the atomic and nuclear comparisons.

requirement: Neutrinos and a held-out test
reported_finding: The same mass-squared splitting enters the reactor oscillation calculation and the cosmological closure with one massive mode.

requirement: Transport in dilute and finite-density gases
reported_finding: With the virial forces and the same size law, the 54 windows per branch for the two gases admit a common correction to diffusion and its relaxation time.

requirement: Condensed matter, electronic transport and plasma
reported_finding: The condensed-matter, electronic-transport and plasma observations are assessed under the conditions of their respective experiments.

requirement: Exact Schwarzschild and Kerr backgrounds
scope: benchmark agreement with competing interpretations unresolved
reported_finding: The Schwarzschild and Kerr vacuum solutions provide the backgrounds and units for the calculation.

requirement: Sign of the growth rate of a Kerr scalar mode
reported_finding: The sign of the growth rate of a scalar mode is checked on the Kerr background under specified boundary conditions.

requirement: Source, feedback and strong-field readout
reported_finding: The Sirius B signal is propagated using the atomic frequency and metric of the same parameter combination. The strong-field background is an input to this calculation.

requirement: Early universe and background
reported_finding: The cosmological comparisons share a background with a specified matter fraction and effective mass.

requirement: Perturbation growth and transfer
reported_finding: The same perturbation closure applies to the microwave background, distances and growth through the transfer calculation in Chapter 5.

requirement: Stability and reactive chemistry
reported_finding: The preparations retain the free fragment and the condition on the separation block. The fluoride threshold is documented for each branch.

requirement: Excited states, channels and dissociation thresholds
reported_finding: The energy, action scale and stiffness of the fluoride family relate its frequencies, the release of one fluorine atom and the formation cycle.

requirement: Protocol, controls and analysis
reported_finding: The behavioural protocol specifies the observations, controls and unit of analysis.

requirement: Cognition test using observations of humans
reported_finding: Human observations support the behavioural comparison under the stated protocol. Chapter 6 examines its interpretation in terms of subjective experience.

requirement: Atomic levels and intervals in H, hydrogen-like systems, He, C, O and Ne
reported_finding: Five hydrogen lines are computed using one charge and fine-structure normalization. Chapter 4 reports frequency ratios separately from the absolute scale.

requirement: Geometry and stability of the molecular panel
reported_finding: All six S–F distances of the spectroscopic preparation fall within the diffraction interval for the mean molecular distance. Other geometries are assessed within their own preparation.

requirement: Isotopes and other cases outside calibration
scope: benchmark agreement with competing interpretations unresolved
reported_finding: The H–D isotope shift probes the change in reduced mass at fixed nuclear charge. D01 reports the discrepancy from the published value and the experimental uncertainty.

requirement: Charge, current, constraints and gauge
reported_finding: The nine integrations of the common preparation use stiffness 2 and inertia 8 in core units.

requirement: Polarization, propagation and the matter–field balance
reported_finding: Current, polarization, propagation and the matter–field balance are checked with the operators of the specified preparation.

requirement: Frequencies, ratios and isotopes
reported_finding: The fluoride frequencies and ratios use the same stiffness and action scale as the calculation of dissociation.

requirement: Selection rules, intensities, phases and amplitudes
reported_finding: One vector readout for all six arms yields integrated intensities and the combination-band profile.

requirement: Held-out species and measurement setups
reported_finding: The weak SF₆ band profile is calibrated on 6,970 samples at two pressures. Transfer to a new preparation would supply an independent test.

requirement: Force and work residuals
reported_finding: The work done by the SF₄ and SF₆ forces and the residual of the mechanical equations for the seven centres are checked.

requirement: Invariances
reported_finding: The forces for SF₄ and SF₆ transform under rotation with a covariance error below 10⁻¹¹ in calculation units.

requirement: Integration steps and reversibility
reported_finding: Step size, return and duration are checked at fixed parameters. The time-step test also uses the same pulse on the 40³ grid.

requirement: Boundary flux
reported_finding: All seven centres move freely. Both boundary fluxes use the same impedance and subtract the propagation bias of the packet.

requirement: Observable comparison in the claimed regime
reported_finding: Frequencies, the energy required to release one fluorine atom and the formation cycle are compared within the specified branch and thermochemical scenario.

requirement: Energy, density and the equation of state
reported_finding: The same cluster radii enter the virials and thermal readouts. Krypton and xenon states are computed with a shared free-energy correction.

requirement: Heat capacities, compressibility and sound speed
reported_finding: Heat capacities and derivatives of the equation of state are evaluated for the preparations and reference states specified in D05.

requirement: Vapour pressure, latent heat and coexistence
reported_finding: A shared free energy and size law relate the two phases, latent heat and calorimetry in both branches. Reduced argon supplies the dense reference.

requirement: Viscosity, temperature and composition
reported_finding: For pure Kr and Xe the four long readouts in branch 0 admit the common gain interval reported in D06. Branch 1 has a short control for each gas.

requirement: Correlations, relaxation, system size and duration
reported_finding: Size and duration tests use six seeds and two sizes. Both estimators are compared over the four specified windows.

requirement: Propagation on a prescribed Schwarzschild background
scope: benchmark agreement with competing interpretations unresolved
reported_finding: Signal propagation is computed on the fixed Schwarzschild background in all 576 combinations.

requirement: Scalar-mode propagation on a prescribed Kerr background
reported_finding: The scalar mode propagates on the same fixed Kerr background in all 576 combinations.

requirement: Dispersion, kinematics, invariants and matter–geometry coupling
reported_finding: The differential redshift of Sirius B is evaluated for both specified backgrounds. Generating the strong-field metric from matter remains a separate question.

requirement: Distances and expansion including covariance
reported_finding: Distances and growth are compared using the covariance conventions of the observations and the common background of each family.

requirement: BAO and CMB projections
reported_finding: BAO distances and microwave-background bands use the same transfer calculation. The TT, TE and EE band scores use diagonal variances.

requirement: Radius, phase and forcing during collapse
reported_finding: Radii and phase are read from eight xenon cycles at the specified forcing. The electrical signal of each cycle gives a relative amplitude.

requirement: Energy, duration, spectrum and gas dependence
reported_finding: The benchmark provides band-integrated spectral comparisons for five gases. Radius and voltage are paired over eight cycles of the xenon preparation.
condition: In the synchronized Hopkins experiment, voltage gives timing and relative amplitude. The spectral band energy is averaged over multiple periods. The available measurements do not determine total absolute energy and a cycle-resolved spectrum for the same flashes.

requirement: Definitions and conditional theorems
reported_finding: The formal results on observations and latent distinctions hold under the assumptions stated in Chapter 6 and Appendix B.

requirement: Bearer, invariant, readout channel and empirical tests
reported_finding: The simulations relate an internal distinction to a probe that makes it readable. Human observations are assessed under the behavioural protocol in Q8.2.

requirement: Masses, mass differences and stability
reported_finding: Nuclear binding and radius calculations use parameters shared with the atomic family. The atlas distinguishes evaluated masses from model results.

requirement: Rates, transitions and lifetimes
reported_finding: State-specific amplitudes calibrated on half-lives and branching data are compatible within the recorded parameter region. The certificate transfers to 384 of 576 combinations.

requirement: Joint compatibility of one parameter combination
scope: conditional agreement on the calibrated benchmark
reported_finding: Of 576 combinations, 192 satisfy the other 67 checks jointly within their stated scope. The introduction to this appendix gives the three qualifications on that joint result.

requirement: Decision, frozen predictions, manuscript and repository
reported_finding: The archived decision, frozen predictions, manuscript and reproduction package constitute the documentary result.
